name: Sonic
disclaimer_extra: Sonic's September 2026 brochure. Rows marked with a triangle on the chart are, in Sonic's words, "optional items that may NOT be available in all locations". Sonic publishes no serving weights, so portions are the cup and count sizes it names. A Cherry Limeade is its own recipe, not a limeade with a cherry add-in -- the two are listed separately here because Sonic lists them separately.
blurb: Sonic publishes a figure for every drink add-in at every cup size, which is why this is the only place you can price a cherry-vanilla Route 44 exactly. Start from a menu item, or build a drink from the cup up.
